scoring_justification: T0 result-level comparison. The verifier cannot re-run full DFT calculations, so it reads the agent's reported total_spin_moment, local_spin_moment, binding_energy, and classification from both JSON files and compares to the paper's Table II / Section 3.2 values with tolerance 0.3 μB for spin moments, exact classification match (with Ti-blue-PBE dual-accept), and Spearman rank correlation ≥0.7 for binding energy trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for total spin moments, local Mulliken spin moments, magnetic classifications, and binding energy ordering extracted from the paper Table II and Section 3.2.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table II: S_tot and S_M columns. Section 3.2 / Fig. 3(a): integer spin moment sequence [0,1,2,3,2,1,0,1] for Sc–Ni. Section 4 / Fig. 5: magnetic classifications (DMS/half-metal/nonmagnetic). Section 3.1 / Fig. 2(c,f): binding energy trend (increase to Cr then decrease).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the paper. Total spin moments are the integer values from Fig. 3(a) and Table II. Local Mulliken moments S_M from Table II. Classifications from Section 4 band structure analysis. Binding energy ordering from the trend described in Section 3.1.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Every gold value traces to a specific paper artifact: Table II for S_tot and S_M, Fig. 3(a) and Section 3.2 for integer spin moment sequence, Section 4 band structure text for classifications, and Section 3.1 for binding energy trend.
